summary: The ui-source revision the set view is built and tested against: the overlay is ui-source at this revision with this folder's src/, tests/ and docs/ laid over it, and ui-builder's package build builds the same (standards simai.component-set 1.0.0 and simai.component-package 1.1.1). It is the source of the released SIMAI Framework pair ui-5edc71bd6936 (simai/ui contracts/releases/ui-5edc71bd6936.lock.json, build_inputs.source). The same commit is framework.source_revision in set.json.
